sh: door swinging wide with light pouring through
f: Knock knock. Nobody. Knock harder.

sh: heavy door slamming shut, dust puff, picture falling off
f: And STAY out.

sh: sparkling hands shaping a glowing blob into a little house
f: Glue, glitter, and a dream.

sh: stone furnace glowing orange with an anvil and hammer sparks
f: Hit hot metal until it becomes a problem.

sh: wobbly stick figure climbing off a page, pencil behind it
f: Drew it badly. It came to life badly.

sh: big red X stamping down on a speech bubble
f: And just like that: cancelled.

sh: huge red-and-black hammer stamped BAN crashing down
f: You have been removed from the server.

sh: up-up-down-down arrows glowing over a controller
f: Up up down down left right left right B A.

sh: grey YOU LOSE banner with a deflating balloon
f: Better luck next respawn.

sh: glittering pink sword slash with sparkles and a hair flip
f: Slay. Both meanings. Simultaneously.

sh: red comic burst reading K.O. with spinning stars
f: K.O.! Flawless. Mostly.

sh: wide red scanning line sweeping and erasing what it crosses
f: Target acquired. Target... where did it go?

sh: green traffic light and a chequered flag whipping down
f: GO GO GO GO GO GO GO GO.

sh: pair of trainers plodding along with nobody in them
f: Running is overrated. So is arriving on time.

sh: big cartoon bottom dropping onto a whoopee cushion
f: Sat. On you. Comfy.

sh: giant gloved finger pointing with a red arrow
f: Look over there! Ha. Made you look.

sh: bobblehead bouncing up and down in agreement
f: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Not listening. Mm-hm.

sh: figure with both palms up and shoulders at ear height
f: Not my problem. Might be yours.

sh: golden pressure ring pushing everything to its knees
f: Kneel before the keyboard.

sh: pressed-together hands in a soft ray of light
f: Hands together. Eyes closed. Heal up.

sh: small raised hand with a polite question mark
f: Can I? Can I? Can I? Pleeease?

sh: stream of speech bubbles full of blah blah blah
f: And another thing. And another. And another.

sh: thought bubble with turning cogs and a chin-stroke hand
f: Hmm. Hmmmm. Hmmmmmmmm. No.

sh: three spinning mystery boxes with question marks
f: Eeny, meeny, miny, YOU.

sh: stack of books with a level-up arrow and a tired candle
f: Knowledge is power. Naps are also power.

sh: pointer stick tapping a chalkboard, chalk flying
f: Class is in session. You are the lesson.

sh: hopscotch grid, skipping rope and a ball mid-bounce
f: Tag. You are it. No tag-backs.

sh: cartoon glove on a spring snatching and retracting
f: Yoink! Finders keepers.

sh: underpants with hearts stretched up over a flagpole
f: Hoisted by their own pants.

sh: toilet bowl whirlpool with a flush handle
f: Flush. Hair by plumbing.

sh: raining footballs, tennis balls, a shuttlecock and a whistle
f: It is not the winning. It is the winning.

sh: black-and-white ball curling into a top corner, net bulging
f: GOOOOOOOOOOOOAL!

sh: fuzzy yellow ball smashed by a racket, chalk dust puff
f: Fifteen-love. Thirty-love. Ouch-love.

sh: dimpled white ball rocketing off a tee, divot flying
f: FORE! That means duck. You did not duck.

sh: stick slapping a black puck across ice, spray of shavings
f: Two minutes for roughing. Worth it.

sh: eight muddy players locked together shoving forward
f: No pads. No helmet. No worries.

sh: feathered cone floating slowly then smashed fast
f: Floats like a feather. Because it is one.

sh: tiny orange ball rallying back and forth at a blur
f: Tik tok tik tok tik tok tik SMASH.

sh: glossy blue ball crashing into ten white pins
f: Strike! Gutter ball. Strike! Gutter ball.

sh: pair of red gloves throwing a one-two, bell ringing
f: Ding ding. Gloves up. Chin down.

sh: volley of arrows arcing toward a ringed target
f: Bullseye. The other bull's eye too.

sh: bobble-hatted skier in a tuck, two poles, powder spray
f: Pizza! French fry! Pizza! TREE!

sh: rider mid-grab over a jump, baggy jacket, goggles
f: Dude. Gnarly. Totally fell on purpose.

sh: figure in a spin on one blade, arms up, ice sparkles
f: Triple axel. Double wobble. Single bruise.

sh: board flipping under mid-air trainers, grind sparks
f: Kickflip! Landed it. Nobody was filming.

sh: leotard figure mid-backflip with a twirling ribbon
f: Stuck the landing. On you.

sh: pyramid of three with pom-poms and a megaphone
f: Give me a W! Give me an I! Give me an N!

sh: red oval lanes with white lines and starting blocks
f: On your marks. Get set. Trip.

sh: flood of numbered runners, water cups, one banana suit
f: 26.2 miles. Somebody ran it as a banana.

sh: chequered flag whipping and speed lines down a straight
f: Last one there is a rotten summon.

sh: tight pack of helmeted riders in lycra leaning into a bend
f: On your left. On your left. ON YOUR LEFT.

sh: bending rod, taut line, red-white float bobbing
f: Caught one THIS big. No photo. Trust me.

sh: walker with huge rucksack, two poles, flask and a map
f: Are we lost? We are not lost. We are lost.

sh: little tent, campfire, marshmallow sticks and a lantern
f: S'mores. Ghost stories. Something outside the tent.

sh: figure balanced in tree pose on a rolled mat, calm aura
f: Breathe in. Breathe out. Bend them like a pretzel.

sh: white frame with a net, ball bulging in the back
f: Back of the net!

sh: red team shirt with a big number 10 flying like a flag
f: Number 10. Automatically 30% better.

sh: polished wood floor with painted lines and a gavel banging
f: Order! Order in the court! Also, travelling.

sh: striped mown grass with white lines and corner flags
f: Get off the grass. Unless you are winning.

sh: oval sheet of scratched ice ringed with boards
f: Everyone slides. Nobody stops.

sh: flip-number board rolling up to 999 with flashing bulbs
f: New high score! Enter initials: AAA.

sh: brown oval ball spiked into turf, arms raised
f: Spike it. Dance. Flag for excessive joy.

sh: baseball with red stitching sailing over a fence into orbit
f: Going, going, gone. So is the window.

sh: crouching player in mask, chest pad and a huge mitt
f: Catches everything. Colds included.

sh: basketball bouncing in a zigzag between falling defenders
f: Crossed up. Ankles: gone.

sh: referee hand holding up a bright red card, whistle blast
f: REF! Are you blind? Yes. Yes he is.

sh: ball on a white spot, keeper diving the wrong way
f: He goes left. The ball goes right. Scenes.

sh: bracket board, gold cup on a plinth and ticker tape
f: It is coming home. Probably. Maybe. No.

sh: black quaver note bouncing along five wavy lines
f: Do re mi fa so la ti DOH.

sh: three stacked notes blasting out with lightning edges
f: Three chords and the truth. Mostly the chords.

sh: stage with light beams, speaker stacks and a sea of hands
f: Ears will ring until Thursday. Worth it.

sh: three swinging brass bells sending out ringing rings
f: Ding dong. Ding DONG. DING DONG.

sh: black speaker cabinet with glowing valves, cone thumping
f: This one goes to eleven.

sh: smooth gold saxophone notes in a smoky blue swirl
f: It is about the notes you do not play. Skiddly bop.

sh: slow blue notes drifting from a lonely harmonica
f: Woke up this morning. Lost the round. Dog left.

sh: grand singer in a horned helmet shattering a glass
f: It is not over until she sings. She is singing.

sh: cool sunglasses emoji leaning back with EZ in neon
f: Easy peasy lemon squeezy. Famous last words.

sh: laughing-crying face rolling on the floor, tears spraying
f: Laughed so hard the summon fell over.

sh: flaming skateboard launching off a ramp into nothing
f: You only live once. Statistically, briefly.

sh: strutting figure in shades, gold chain, cap sideways
f: Too cool to dodge. Does not need to.

sh: icy outfit: puffer, chain and trainers dripping sparkles
f: The fit is immaculate. The puddle is growing.

sh: two dice and a handshake over a stack of chips
f: Bet. No, really. Bet.

sh: giant glowing green letter W with a crown on it
f: Common W. Take it. Frame it.

sh: giant red letter L thrown like a boomerang
f: Hold this. It is heavy. It is an L.

sh: tiny reply bubble with a thousand hearts over a big sad one
f: Ratio. Plus you fell off. Plus no summons.

sh: beige shrugging blob with a 5/10 scorecard
f: Not bad. Not good. Just... mid.

sh: red signal icon reading 999 ms, rubber-banding
f: 999 ms. That hit landed last Tuesday.

sh: huge gasping face with hands on cheeks, shock lines
f: Oh. My. GOSH. Did you SEE that?

sh: wide-open amazed mouth face with sparkles and hype bars
f: Poggers. That was actually poggers.

sh: wheezing laugh lines with a slapped knee
f: Kek. An ancient laugh from the old servers.

sh: blushing kawaii face with sparkle eyes and tiny paws
f: Notices your summon. OwO what's this?

sh: blank-faced suit man beside a green arrow shooting up
f: Line goes up. Nobody knows why. Stonks.

sh: ultra-jawed black-and-white bodybuilder, tiny smile
f: Yes.

sh: grump in socks and sandals mowing a lawn, newspaper
f: Back in my day, summons walked uphill both ways.

sh: kid filming a dance on a phone, oversized hoodie
f: Attention span: this long. What were we

sh: confident figure standing on a solid stone pedestal
f: Based on what? Based on this pedestal.

sh: screaming crowd with glow sticks, banners and merch
f: WE LOVE YOU! They mean it. Run.

sh: bouncing yellow faces: grin, cry-laugh, heart-eyes, skull
f: A thousand words. All of them faces.

sh: phone on a stick with a blinding flash and a pout
f: But first, let me blind you.

sh: big blue # spinning like a four-point throwing star
f: #Blessed. #Hit. #Ouch.

sh: blue thumbs-up badge with a +1 popping off
f: Like and subscribe. Mostly like.

sh: red SUBSCRIBE button with a ringing bell
f: Hit the bell. The bell hits back.

sh: conga line of little avatar icons trailing behind
f: Ten new followers. All of them bots.

sh: thumbnail with a shocked face, red arrow and red circle
f: You will NOT believe what happens next. (Bonk.)

sh: flashing window: SKIP AD IN 5, tiny hidden X button
f: Your fight will resume after these messages.

sh: padlock screen with dots ******** and a red WRONG
f: Must contain a capital, a number and your soul.

sh: falling rounded-square icons with red notification dots
f: There is an app for that. It wants your location.

sh: browser window with a spinning wheel and ERROR 404
f: 404: enemy not found.

sh: underlined blue text chain yanking toward a pointer hand
f: Do not click it. You clicked it.

sh: winged envelope with a red unread badge reading 9,999
f: I hope this summon finds you well.

sh: green chat bubble with three bouncing typing dots
f: Seen at 4:02. No reply. Devastating.

sh: floating screen with a play triangle and a buffering ring
f: Buffering... buffering... buff... ering.

sh: small bright rectangle with huge shocked face and arrows
f: Bigger mouth means more views. Science.

sh: blocky default character, plain shirt, blank smile, T-pose
f: Default skin. Default face. Maximum menace.

sh: big room of idle jumping avatars under a countdown clock
f: Waiting for players... 1 of 12.

sh: avatar with a gold crown tag floating over its head
f: Has the crown icon. Has the ban button.

sh: progress bar stuck at 99% with spinning arrows
f: Installing 1 of 247. Do not turn off.

sh: glowing gold aura with stat arrows all pointing up
f: Please nerf. Seriously. Devs. Please.

sh: sparking snapped gadget with a spring boinging out
f: It was like that when I got here.

sh: ranked chart with one glowing gold entry at the top
f: Everyone runs it. That is why it is boring.

sh: spoon aeroplane flying toward an open mouth
f: Here comes the aeroplane. Open wide.

sh: controller smashed on the floor, screen reading DISCONNECTED
f: Alt. F4. Slam. Silence.

sh: grumpy salt shaker pouring a cloud of crystals
f: So salty the sea is jealous.

sh: bubbling green sludge with a skull-free hazard trefoil
f: Muted. Reported. Still glowing.

sh: your own double in a mirror frame, pointing thumbs at itself
f: The best summon. Modest, too.

sh: mirror-image rival pointing straight back at you
f: No, YOU.

sh: group hug of five mismatched friends, arms round shoulders
f: There is no us without u. And s.

sh: shifty figure being pointed at by three giant arrows
f: It was them. They did it. Definitely.

sh: shapeless something under a sheet, one tentacle poking out
f: What is it? Nobody knows. It is coming.

sh: big arrow pointing down at a random thing, then another
f: This. No, that. No, THIS.

sh: silhouette with a question mark for a face, owl hoot
f: Who? Who? No, seriously. Who?

sh: shock ring of interrobangs and tilted heads
f: WHAT? WHAT? ...what?

sh: endless stream of tiny WHY? WHY? WHY? bubbles
f: Why? Because. Why? Because. Why? Bedtime.

sh: instruction leaflet unfolding forever, missing step three
f: Step one. Step two. Step four. Good luck.

sh: egg timer and a loading bar that never finishes
f: Soon. Define soon. No.

sh: spinning map pin over an upside-down map
f: You are here. "Here" is not on the map.

sh: big waving hand with a speech bubble HI! and sparkles
f: Hi! Hello! Hey! Over here! HI!

sh: huge sparkling puppy-dog eyes and clasped hands
f: The magic word. Works 60% of the time.

sh: little bow with a gift tag and a gold star
f: You are welcome. That will be one high five.

sh: starburst with WOW in comic letters and wide eyes
f: Wow. Much summon. Very attack.

sh: red comic burst reading OUCH with a throbbing thumb
f: Ouch. Right in the hit points.

sh: green disgusted face with tongue out and wavy stink lines
f: Ewwwww. Get it away. Get it AWAY.

sh: licking-lips face with a fork, knife and a bib
f: Compliments to the chef. Seconds, please.

sh: numbered balls tumbling from a spinning cage, dabber marks
f: Two fat ladies, 88. Legs eleven. BINGO!

sh: red HELLO MY NAME IS sticker, scribbled out twice
f: xX_Summon_Slayer_Xx was taken.

sh: small jar of coins with a sticky note: FOR CHORES
f: Five whole coins. Spend it all in one shop.

sh: sweeping dark blanket with a clock striking nine
f: It is past your bedtime. All of you. Bed.

sh: overflowing mound of white bubbles hiding everything
f: Put in too much soap. Way too much.

sh: purple bar filling up and bursting into LEVEL UP!
f: +50 XP. For typing. Nice.

sh: brass coin stamped with a star and NO CASH VALUE
f: No cash value. Much smack value.

sh: huge floating red number -9999 with a crit starburst
f: -9999. It is super effective.

sh: floating glowing box with a question mark and a star inside
f: Bonk it from below. Classic technique.

sh: glowing blue circle pad with beams where figures pop in
f: They just keep coming out. Who is making these?

sh: spinning grey circle and a bar that jumps back to 12%
f: Loading... Tip: have you tried dodging?

sh: dark panel: RESUME, OPTIONS, QUIT, with a blinking cursor
f: Paused. You cannot pause an online game, Mum.

sh: grid of slots spilling 99 potions, a boot and a fish
f: Inventory full. Of what? Mostly cheese wheels.

sh: glowing waypoint diamond with a distance counter
f: Your mission, should you choose to type it.

sh: pop-up banner with a trophy icon sliding in from the corner
f: Achievement unlocked: read the flavour text.

sh: three-step podium with bronze, silver and gold badges
f: Hardstuck bronze. It is the teammates. Obviously.

sh: flaming counter ticking 3... 4... 5... with a fire trail
f: He is on fire! Someone fetch a bucket. Or do not.

sh: ring girl card reading ROUND 1 and a bell being struck
f: Round one. FIGHT!

sh: closing purple energy ring with a shrinking safe circle
f: The circle is closing. You are not in it.

sh: charging mob of mixed heroes with a war horn and loot bags
f: Forty people. One boss. Nobody read the guide.

sh: two back-to-back heroes, one red one blue, fist bump
f: Player two has entered the game.

sh: lone hooded figure against the wind, scarf trailing
f: No team. No heals. No problem.

sh: tumbling red triangle, blue square, yellow circle, star
f: Wrong hole. Wrong hole. Wrong hole. There.

sh: perfect blue ring spinning round its target
f: Round and round. No corners to hide in.

sh: flat red square stamping down, four sharp corners
f: Four sides. All of them against you.

sh: long green slab sliding sideways like a door
f: A square that got stretched. Still bitter.

sh: purple squashed circle wobbling as it rolls
f: A circle after lunch.

sh: solid orange cube tumbling corner over corner
f: Six faces. None of them friendly.

sh: flawless shiny cyan ball with one highlight
f: No edges. No weaknesses. No personality.

sh: grey drum shape rolling on its side
f: Rolls one way. Thuds the other.

sh: interlocking gold six-sided tiles forming a dome
f: Six sides. The bees were right all along.

sh: long black ruler-straight line racing across the ground
f: Do not cross it. Wait your turn. Sign here.

sh: bouncing red polka dots of different sizes
f: Connect them. Too slow.

sh: rolling black and white bars like a runaway crossing
f: Do these make the battlefield look wide?

sh: spinning purple-pink hypno swirl
f: Look into the swirl. Looook. Sleeepy.

sh: big red X spinning like a blade
f: X marks the spot. The spot is you.

sh: chunky green plus sign with a +1 popping out
f: One more. And one more. And one more.

sh: flat red minus bar thrown like a stick
f: Minus one. Minus one. Minus you.

sh: big hollow number 0 that things fall through
f: Zero. Zip. Nada. The whole nothing.

sh: floating glowing sign: @ # & % cycling quickly
f: @#&%! Pardon its language.

sh: tall concrete block with rows of lit windows
f: Twelve floors. The lift is broken.

sh: white domed hall with slim towers and a crescent top
f: Calm inside. Solid outside. Shoes off.

sh: red-brick hall with a clock tower and ivy, students napping
f: Four years of learning. Mostly about instant noodles.

sh: small shop with striped awning and crates of fruit outside
f: Went in for milk. Came out with nine things. No milk.

sh: grey paving slabs with cracks, gum spots and a hopscotch
f: Step on a crack. Go on. See what happens.

sh: white road stripes with a lollipop STOP sign held up
f: Look left. Look right. Look left again. Stay.

sh: crossed roads jammed with honking cars and a stuck light
f: Nobody moves. Everybody honks.

sh: big silver screen, projector beam, popcorn flying
f: No talking. No phones. No refunds.

sh: warehouse with spotlights, cameras and an ON AIR sign
f: Quiet on set! That includes screaming.

sh: map-shaped slab with a flag, border posts and an anthem
f: Has a flag, an anthem and strong opinions.

sh: fortified bunker with antenna, sandbags and a flag
f: Home sweet heavily fortified home.

sh: lean-to of branches and tarp with a tiny fire inside
f: Four sticks and a tarp. Home.

sh: wonky wooden shack with a KEEP OUT sign and a periscope
f: No grown-ups. No siblings. Password required.
